title: react-markdown security (paraphrase)
text: react-markdown is safe by default: raw HTML in Markdown is not rendered unless the rehype-raw plugin is added. URLs pass through a urlTransform function whose default only allows safe protocols such as http, https, mailto and relative links, so javascript: links are removed. When raw HTML is enabled, the documentation recommends a sanitizer such as rehype-sanitize.
